  • Field Details

    • gift

      private Gift gift
      Information about the gift

    • ownedGiftId

      @SerializedName("owned_gift_id") private String ownedGiftId
      Optional. Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts

    • convertStarCount

      @SerializedName("convert_star_count") private Integer convertStarCount
      Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible

    • prepaidUpgradeStarCount

      @SerializedName("prepaid_upgrade_star_count") private Integer prepaidUpgradeStarCount
      Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid by the sender for the ability to upgrade the gift

    • canBeUpgraded

      @SerializedName("can_be_upgraded") private Boolean canBeUpgraded
      Optional. True, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift

    • text

      private String text
      Optional. Text of the message that was added to the gift

    • entities

      private List<MessageEntity> entities
      Optional. Special entities that appear in the text

    • isPrivate

      @SerializedName("is_private") private Boolean isPrivate
      Optional. True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them

    • isUpgradeSeparate

      @SerializedName("is_upgrade_separate") private Boolean isUpgradeSeparate
      Optional. True, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent

    • uniqueGiftNumber

      @SerializedName("unique_gift_number") private Integer uniqueGiftNumber
      Optional. Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded.
